servers.name: Remote MCP Server (Authless)

servers.description: Enables generation of various chart types (bar, line, pie, scatter, radar, heatmap, and more) using ECharts library, returning preview URLs to visualize data through natural language requests.
servers.name: ECharts MCP Server

servers.description: Provides comprehensive WhatsApp Business API functionality with 18 tools for sending messages, media, interactive buttons/lists, templates, reactions, and managing message status through the PyWA library.

WHATSAPP_TOKEN.description: Your WhatsApp Cloud API access token

WHATSAPP_PHONE_ID.description: Your WhatsApp Business phone number ID

servers.name: PyWA MCP Server

servers.description: Enables AI assistants to search YouTube videos using the official YouTube Data API v3, extract full video transcripts in multiple languages, and store/retrieve video summaries using a local database.

RAPIDAPI_KEY.description: Your RapidAPI key for transcript extraction

DATABASE_PATH.description: Optional: Custom path for the video summaries database file

YOUTUBE_API_KEY.description: Your YouTube Data API v3 key for search functionality

servers.name: YouTube Tools MCP Server

servers.description: A Next.js-based MCP server template that implements OAuth 2.1 authentication with support for both SSE and Streamable HTTP transports. Provides a reference implementation for building authenticated MCP servers that work with Claude, Cursor, VSCode, and other MCP clients.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection string (required if you need SSE transport to work, i.e. you want to support Claude Desktop and Web)

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL database connection string (required for OAuth authentication to work, this is where sessions etc. live)

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Any random string for Better Auth

NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: The base URL for the Next.js application

servers.name: OAuth 2.1 MCP Server

servers.description: Enables AI agents to create, manage, and track tasks within plans using Valkey as the persistence layer. Supports plan and task management with Markdown notes, status tracking, and prioritization through multiple transport protocols (SSE, Streamable HTTP, STDIO).

ENABLE_SSE.description: Enable Server-Sent Events (SSE) transport protocol. Set to 'true' to enable SSE endpoints at /sse/*

ENABLE_STDIO.description: Enable STDIO transport protocol for direct process communication via standard input/output

ENABLE_STREAMABLE_HTTP.description: Enable Streamable HTTP transport protocol. Set to 'true' to enable HTTP endpoint at /mcp

servers.name: Valkey MCP Task Management Server

servers.description: Provides comprehensive database management tools for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite databases. Enables querying table structures, executing read-only and write queries, exporting DDL statements, and managing database metadata through natural language.

DATABASE_URL.description: The database connection string (e.g., postgresql://user:pass@localhost/mydb, mysql://root:pass@localhost:3306/testdb, or sqlite://path/to/db.sqlite). Can also be provided via --database-url command line argument or database_url parameter in tool calls.

servers.name: SQLx MCP Server

servers.description: Enables AI agents to facilitate cryptocurrency tipping using x402 payment collection and CDP automatic disbursement. Supports USDC tips on Base and Solana with automatic payment splitting (96% recipient, 4% platform) through dedicated wallets.

CDP_API_KEY_ID.description: Your Coinbase Developer Platform API key ID (Required for CDP disbursement)

CDP_API_KEY_SECRET.description: Your Coinbase Developer Platform API key secret (Required for CDP disbursement)

X402_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Your x402 wallet private key (Required for payment collection)

servers.name: tip.md x402 + CDP MCP Server

servers.description: A distributed task management server that provides todo list operations with AI-powered task prioritization using OpenAI, built on Redis for shared state across multiple nodes.

NODE_ID.description: Optional identifier for the node (useful for multi-node deployments)

REDIS_URL.description: The Redis connection URL for distributed state management

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your OpenAI API key for AI-powered task prioritization

servers.name: MCP Todo Server
